first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter, simpler onboarding flow because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests onboarding improvements can lift time-to-value and SMB activation. I would verify the onboarding and signup records first, while guarding against removing qualification signals that could reduce downstream qualified revenue.

mid.rationale: Run a small, guarded test of shortened onboarding, prioritizing the direct current problems of declining completion and activation. The verified onboarding result improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while signup simplification also improved SMB activation but showed a slight retention decline and did not generalize beyond SMB. Limit rollout, preserve qualification and segment tracking, and evaluate qualified revenue and retention before scaling.

final2.rationale: The competitor’s deeper SMB price cut and doubled churn conversations create an immediate, segment-specific revenue threat. Run targeted promotional pricing only for price-sensitive SMB prospects or at-risk accounts, with strict eligibility, time limits, and holdouts. Track qualified revenue, gross margin, retention, conversion, and cannibalization; do not apply a broad discount without confirming sustainable economics.
